lead: A board: columns of cards that can be dragged between columns and within one. The data is flat `columns` + `cards` (each card has a `columnId`; the array order is the order within the column); the caller owns the state and gets the new array back through `onCardsChange`. While dragging, cards move to their new place live; with the keyboard use Alt + arrow keys, and every move is announced to screen readers.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Drag a card to another column or within its column; with a card focused, Alt + Left / Right moves it to another column and Alt + Up / Down reorders it.
usage.hint: Drag a card to another column or reorder it; drag a column header to reorder columns.

actions.title: Click and Add
actions.description: `onCardClick` makes a card a button (Enter opens it); `onAddCard` adds "Add card" at the bottom of each column (typed in place, Enter keeps adding).
actions.hint: Click a card, or add one at the bottom of a column.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` sets the column width and gap: sm 240px, md 280px, lg 320px.

column-menu.title: Add, Edit and Manage
column-menu.description: `onAddCard` / `onAddColumn` add in place; `onCardEdit` opens a dialog on click to edit the title, description, labels, progress and footer (like Trello); `onColumnRename` / `onColumnDelete` / `collapsible` turn on the column header's … menu: rename (double-clicking the title works too), collapse into a narrow strip (cards can still be dragged in), delete (after a confirmation; the page removes the column and its cards).
column-menu.hint: Use the … on a column header, or double-click a title; click a card to edit it in a dialog (it has a Delete button; the Delete key works too).

height.title: Fixed Height
height.description: With `height`, each column is at most that tall: the header and "Add" stay fixed, the cards scroll inside the column and the board only scrolls horizontally; dragging to a column's top or bottom edge scrolls it.

readonly.title: Read Only
readonly.description: Without `onCardsChange` / `onCardMove` cards can't be dragged and are only shown; an empty column shows a hint.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The board root (`section`); `data-size`, and `data-dragging` while dragging
styling.column: The column and its header; the column has `data-column-id`, and `data-over` while a card is dragged over it; the status dot has `data-color`
styling.body: The column body (light background), the card list, a list item, the empty-column hint, the "Add" button at the bottom
styling.card: A card; `data-card-id`, `data-column-id`; `data-draggable` when it can be dragged, `data-dragging` while dragged
styling.cardParts: The card's title, description and footer
styling.labels: The row of labels; each label has `data-color`
styling.progress: The progress bar (`role=progressbar`); the fill reads `--kanban-progress`
